build_stereo_correspondences_estimator: build a StereoCorrespondencesEstimator model with backbone, embed_dims, num_layers, and decode heads for stereo image analysis
extract_feat_stereo: extract features from two input images using the backbone and transformer layers with positional embeddings
encode_decode_stereo: encode two images with backbone and decode into descriptor maps of the same size as input
loss_by_feat_stereo: compute correspondence loss between features of two images using StereoPointmapCorrespondenceLoss
predict_stereo_correspondences: predict stereo correspondences for two input images and return SegDataSample with pred_desc1 and pred_desc2
